tool.name: Embedding search with FAISS
tool.description: look up entity descriptions in a FAISS knowledge-base index

param.name: input
param.label: Paragraphs with entities
param.help: JSON Lines, one object per paragraph, with a "spans" list. Every span needs "start" and "end" positions in its paragraph, as the NER tool writes them.

param.name: faiss_index
param.label: FAISS index
param.help: The index of the knowledge base, for example topostext.index.

param.name: metadata
param.label: Knowledge-base metadata (JSON Lines)
param.help: One JSON object per line, for example topostext_metadata.jsonl. Line N describes vector N of the index.

param.name: id_field
param.label: ID field in the metadata
param.help: The field that identifies an entry, copied into the results. Leave empty to use the line number (starting at 0).

validator.message: Use letters, digits, dots, dashes and underscores only.

param.name: embedding_model
param.label: Embedding model
param.help: The Hugging Face model that built the index. The index does not say which one it was, and a different model gives wrong results.

validator.message: Use the form owner/name, for example google/embeddinggemma-2.

param.name: query_prompt
param.label: Query prompt
param.help: The name of the model's prompt for search queries (EmbeddingGemma uses SearchQuery). Leave empty if the model has none.

validator.message: Use letters, digits, dots, dashes and underscores only.

param.name: query_source
param.label: Text to look up
param.help: The mention alone worked best in tests: with more text around it, the other words in the sentence start to decide the result.
param.option: The mention itself (the characters from start to end)
A field of the span, for example a description written by an LLM

validator.message: Use letters, digits, dots, dashes and underscores only.

param.name: top_k
param.label: Results per span
param.help: How many candidates to keep for the reranking step. 30 found the right place much more often than 10.

param.name: normalize
param.label: Normalize the query vectors
param.help: Keep this on if the index was built from normalized vectors, as the ToposText index was.

param.name: dtype
param.label: Numeric precision of the model
param.help: The default matches the notebook. float32 is a little more precise, but the order of the last results can change.

param.name: batch_size
param.label: Texts per batch
param.help: Larger batches are faster but need more memory.

tool.help:
**Embedding search with FAISS** finds, for every entity in a text, the entries of a knowledge base that fit it best. It embeds the mention (or, if you choose, a description of it) and looks the vector up in a FAISS index. It is the retrieval step of the `T4.5.2 Geotagging of texts <https://github.com/atrium-research/T4.5.2_Geotagging_of_texts>`_ workflow.
Input -----
* **Paragraphs with entities**: JSON Lines, for example from the NER tool::
{"text": "He sailed to Delphi.", "spans": [{"start": 14, "end": 20, "label": "PLACE"}]}
The mention is the text from ``start`` to ``end``. Alternatively, look up a field of the span, such as a short description of the entity written by an LLM step.
* **FAISS index** and **metadata**: the knowledge base. Line N of the metadata (JSON Lines) describes vector N of the index, so they must come from the same knowledge base. For ToposText, take ``topostext.index`` and ``topostext_metadata.jsonl`` from the `release page <https://github.com/atrium-research/T4.5.2_Geotagging_of_texts/releases/tag/v.2>`_. Any other knowledge base works the same way. * **Embedding model**: the model that built the index. The tool checks that its vectors have the size of the index, but it cannot tell two models of the same size apart, so choose the right one.
Output ------
The same JSON Lines, with ``index_results`` added to every span: the ids of the nearest entries, best first. Galaxy has no JSON Lines datatype, so the file is labelled ``json``.
The model is downloaded when the job runs, so the server needs internet access.
